## What Is a Listing?

A listing is a Quarto feature that automatically builds a page of links from other pages in your project. Instead of writing a link for every project by hand, you point the listing at a folder, and Quarto reads each file's title, description, and categories to build the cards.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why it's useful for a portfolio
When I add a new project, I just drop a new `.qmd` file into the `projects` folder. The listing updates itself the next time the site renders.
:::

## How It Works

The listing is set up in this page's YAML header:

```{.yaml filename="listings.qmd"}
listing:
  contents: projects      # folder to pull pages from
  type: grid              # card layout (other options: default, table)
  categories: true        # adds clickable category filters
  sort: "title"
  fields: [title, description, categories]
  grid-columns: 3
```

Each project page only needs a short header:

```{.yaml filename="projects/efcu-dashboard.qmd"}
---
title: "EFCU Member Opinion Dashboard"
description: "A Quarto dashboard summarizing a credit union member survey."
categories: [Dashboard, R, Survey Research]
---
```

## The Three Listing Types

| Type | What it looks like | Best for |
|---|---|---|
| `default` | A list with titles and descriptions | Blogs and articles |
| `grid` | Cards in columns | Portfolios and projects |
| `table` | A sortable table | Many items with dates or numbers |
